class.name: PatternSpawner2D
class.brief_description: Where and when a spawner fires: patterns, cadence, spin, movement, graze and sound settings.
class.description: The base of [BulletSpawner2D] (bullets): everything that decides WHERE and WHEN a shot fires, shared by every spawner type. The pattern sources and their editor preview, the Transform subgroup, cadence (auto-fire, [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys], [method fire_n_volleys] budgets, bursts, telegraph, [method spawn_pattern_list] and [method shoot_once_with]), spin, Path2D movement and [method teleport], [member BulletSpawner2D.time_scale], placement randomization, and the graze and sound target settings. Its settings are properties of the concrete spawners ([BulletSpawner2D], [LaserSpawner2D]): each lays them out in its own inspector order and leaves out what does nothing for it. Their accessors and every method here belong to this class, so a script holding any spawner as a [PatternSpawner2D] (an emitter template) calls them alike. It cannot be added to a scene by itself: add a [BulletSpawner2D], whose own section of the inspector (Bullets, Homing, Orbiting, Flocking, Splitting) decides WHAT each shot fires. Errors and warnings from this part name the spawner's own class.

method.name: apply_pattern_preset
method.description: Applies a named starter pattern (radial dense/sparse, 3-arm spiral, narrow/wide aimed fan, slow ring, gap wall, rain, 6-petal flower, scatter burst, cross burst, star shell, heart bloom, snake wave, waterfall curtain, petal storm via Rose, twin counter-spiral, aimed trap via Corridor, blossom finale via Rose, terrain crest via Custom) and switches pattern_source to match. Presets are clean: every Patterns number, switch and vector knob and Spin (the spin angle included) first return to their defaults, so the same preset always gives the same pattern; the user lists ([member BulletSpawner2D.helper_skip_indices], [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_outline_layer_scales], [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_custom_transforms]) are kept like the wiring. The Transform subgroup (scales, muzzle offset, skip indices) and node wiring (aimed target, Path2D, custom array) are kept. Nothing fires. Custom (-1) does nothing; other values out of range fail loud. The twin counter-spiral and blossom finale presets turn spin on.

method.name: begin_burst
method.description: Starts a burst chain by hand (waves and boss phases): [member BulletSpawner2D.burst_count] shots, [member BulletSpawner2D.burst_interval_sec] apart, telegraphed first when [member BulletSpawner2D.telegraph_enabled]. Clears any pending telegraph first. Manual chains run whether auto-shooting is on or not; chains started by the auto loop are clamped to [method volleys_remaining] (also when [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] or a [method fire_n_volleys] budget changes mid-chain: the chain ends where they end) and cancelled when auto-shooting is switched off.

method.name: collect_spawn_transforms
method.description: Returns one global transform per bullet for the current [member BulletSpawner2D.pattern_source]. Empty [member BulletSpawner2D.transforms_generator] means this node. Children mode with no markers falls back to the generator itself. Aimed mode with no target returns an empty array. Corridor mode with no target falls back to [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_corridor_aim_direction] so the wall still draws. Every helper pattern returns exactly [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_bullets_amount] transforms (gaps and fills included), minus any [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_skip_indices].

method.name: debug_check_layer_coincidence
method.description: Verifies every layered preview dot sits on its yellow ring (same center-scale rule and same fill deal on both sides). Returns checked/layers/max_deviation_px/mean_deviation_px/ok. Empty preview returns checked=false. Point-to-segment match: exact on sharp shapes, sub-pixel on dense sweeps.

method.name: debug_collect_spawn_transforms_uncached
method.description: Same output as [method collect_spawn_transforms], always regenerated from scratch (the bake cache is bypassed). The reference the cache-parity tests compare against.

method.name: debug_ease
method.description: Static test hook: the easing value movement uses at [param t] for a [enum Tween.TransitionType] and [enum Tween.EaseType]. Matches [method Tween.interpolate_value] for every transition and ease (pinned by tests).

method.name: debug_get_graze_detector_stats
method.description: Graze target finder instrumentation: scans (target scans run by this spawner's own lists), lists (target lists it keeps), shares_factory_lists (true for [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_target_source] Node Group with no [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_filter_group] and [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_update_interval] 0: its volleys then share the factory's one scan per group per tick with every factory volley of that group, counted in [method BulletFactory2D.debug_get_graze_stats]).

method.name: debug_get_graze_preview_circles
method.description: The graze preview's rings exactly as drawn: an Array of {center, radius, color, zone_index, ring_index, target_id}. Empty while the preview is off.

method.name: debug_get_graze_preview_stats
method.description: Graze preview instrumentation: active, visible, circles, draws (how many times the layer redrew).

method.name: debug_get_layer_rings
method.description: Debug readout of the yellow preview rings: one PackedVector2Array per extra outline layer, exactly as drawn (holder-local; runs INF-separated with a closing duplicate per closed run). Empty when layers are inactive. Lets scripts and tests verify bullets sit on their rings without screenshotting the editor.

method.name: debug_get_pattern_cache_info
method.description: Bake cache introspection: [code]hits[/code], [code]misses[/code], [code]bakes[/code], [code]version[/code] (bumped by every pattern-affecting change), and [code]shot_class[/code] / [code]preview_class[/code]: -1 not baked yet, 0 regenerated every shot, 1 reused under translation only, 2 reused under any rigid motion.

method.name: debug_get_pattern_cache_verify
method.description: Whether the static cache verifier is on (see [method debug_set_pattern_cache_verify]).

method.name: debug_get_preview_arrows
method.description: The facing arrows of the pattern preview as drawn, in the preview holder's space: [code]tails[/code] (where each shaft starts, just past its dot), [code]dirs[/code] (unit directions) and [code]length[/code] (the shaft length: [member BulletSpawner2D.preview_arrow_length] for bullets, the laser's [member LaserData2D.length] for a [LaserSpawner2D] with laser data). Empty while no preview is drawn.

method.name: debug_get_preview_dot_points
method.description: Preview bullet dots exactly as drawn (holder-local). Empty when the preview is off. Lets tests prove dots sit on the preview track.

method.name: debug_get_preview_stats
method.description: Preview instrumentation: [code]rebuilds[/code], [code]last_rebuild_usec[/code], [code]dots_draws[/code], [code]arrows_draws[/code]. Spinning or moving the spawner leaves all four flat: the pose is applied as a node transform, never as a rebuild or redraw.

method.name: debug_get_preview_track_closed
method.description: Debug/test helper: whether the drawn preview base track closes its last point back to the first.

method.name: debug_get_preview_track_points
method.description: Preview base track polyline exactly as drawn (holder-local, INF-separated runs). Empty when the preview is off. Lets tests prove the track rotates with the marker like the volley does.

method.name: debug_get_run_frame_count
method.description: Debug: how many steps the runtime loop ran (one per frame in either [member BulletSpawner2D.process_callback], also across a switch made inside the physics step).

method.name: debug_set_pattern_cache_verify
method.description: Static switch for all spawners: when on, every shot or preview served from the bake cache is regenerated uncached and compared, and a mismatch pushes the error [code]BulletSpawner2D: pattern cache mismatch[/code]. Doubles generation cost: for tests only (the GUT base class turns it on for every suite).

method.name: fire_n_volleys
method.description: Arms a budget of n more volleys, then pauses. Counts every fired volley (auto or manual). [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] is never touched, so unlimited stays unlimited. A spent budget clears itself: [method volleys_remaining] and a later [method resume_shooting] behave like an unlimited spawner again. Replaces any previous budget; unpauses a paused spawner. Rejected when n is not above zero. Works before the spawner enters the tree too (kept through _ready).

method.name: get_bullet_factory
method.description: Returns the factory from [member BulletSpawner2D.bullet_factory_path], or null when unset or invalid.

method.name: get_burst_shots_left
method.description: Shots left in the current burst chain (0 when idle). Waves and HUD can poll this to sequence phases.

method.name: get_burst_time_left
method.description: Seconds until the next shot of the running burst chain, on the spawner's own clock ([member BulletSpawner2D.time_scale] applies). 0 when no chain runs.

method.name: get_effective_generator
method.description: Returns the node patterns are built on: the assigned generator, or this spawner when unset or invalid. Never null in the tree.

method.name: get_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Returns the shared aimed target (Aimed cone and Corridor wall), or null when unset.

method.name: get_helper_path2d_node
method.description: Returns the Path2D node used by the Path2D pattern layout, resolved from [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_path2d_path]. Returns null when no path is set or the node is gone. Prefer setting [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_path2d_path] in the inspector; this accessor is for runtime lookups.

method.name: get_movement_leg
method.description: Legs completed since the run started. A leg is one traversal of the path; Ping Pong counts each direction as a leg.

method.name: get_movement_path_node
method.description: The resolved [Path2D] behind [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_path], or null when unset, freed or outside the tree.

method.name: get_movement_progress
method.description: Distance ratio along the path: 0 = path start, 1 = path end, independent of the leg direction.

method.name: get_movement_velocity
method.description: Velocity of the last movement step in px/s, measured over the time the step took (a frame that reaches an endpoint or wraps a Loop reports the motion it ends with); zero while paused, stopped, waiting (start delay, endpoint pause) or not moving. A new [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_path] or [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_space] mid-play is a jump, never travel: zero for that frame. This is the velocity [member BulletSpawner2D.inherit_movement_velocity] adds to bullets.

method.name: get_pattern_list_time_left
method.description: Seconds until the next entry of the running pattern list ([method spawn_pattern_list]), on the spawner's own clock. 0 when no list runs.

method.name: get_process_time_scale
method.description: The factor the spawner's clock currently runs at: [member BulletSpawner2D.time_scale] times [member BulletFactory2D.time_scale] of its factory (1 with no factory), or 0 when the product is not a finite positive number.

method.name: get_setup_warnings
method.description: The same list as the editor's configuration warning icon: no factory, factory path not pointing to a [BulletFactory2D], no spawn data or invisible spawn data, Aimed/Corridor without a target, Path2D pattern without a path, empty Custom pattern, movement on without a path, orbiting without homing. Empty when nothing is misconfigured. Callable from scripts for debug UIs and CI scene checks.

method.name: get_shoot_time_left
method.description: Seconds until the next automatic trigger pull, on the spawner's own clock ([member BulletSpawner2D.time_scale] applies). 0 while auto-fire is off, paused or spent.

method.name: get_spin_angle_deg
method.description: Current spin angle in degrees. Only advances at runtime while [member BulletSpawner2D.spin_enabled] is on.

method.name: get_telegraph_time_left
method.description: Seconds until the telegraphed shot fires, on the spawner's own clock. 0 when no warning is in progress (see [method is_telegraph_pending]).

method.name: get_transforms_generator
method.description: Returns the assigned generator, or null when unset. Use [method get_effective_generator] when you need the fallback included.

method.name: get_volleys_fired
method.description: Volleys fired since the last (re)arm. Reset with [method reset_shooting].

method.name: is_movement_playing
method.description: True while the run is playing, including its start delay and endpoint pauses; false when paused, stopped or finished.

method.name: is_pattern_list_active
method.description: Whether a pattern list is currently queued/firing.

method.name: is_shooting_active
method.description: Effective shooting state: switch on, not paused, cap not reached. This is configured state (true outside the tree too), not whether a tick is imminent.

method.name: is_shooting_paused
method.description: Whether [method pause_shooting] is latched. While set, no volley is created (burst, telegraph, pattern-list and timer chains freeze); spin, retargeting and preview keep running.

method.name: is_telegraph_pending
method.description: True while a telegraph warning is counting down to its shot (see [member BulletSpawner2D.telegraph_sec]).

method.name: movement_pause
method.description: Freezes the movement in place, keeping progress, leg and timers; [method movement_play] resumes from there.

method.name: movement_play
method.description: Starts the movement, or resumes it after [method movement_pause]. A finished or stopped run restarts from the beginning ([member BulletSpawner2D.movement_start_ratio] and [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_start_delay_sec] apply again). Emits [signal movement_started] when it was not already playing. Runtime only: ignored in the editor.

method.name: movement_reverse
method.description: Flips the current leg's direction in place: the spawner turns around where it is and the eased progress continues smoothly the other way.

method.name: movement_seek
method.description: Jumps to [param ratio] (0..1) of the current leg, measured along the leg's direction, and moves the spawner there. A NaN or out-of-range ratio fails loud and is ignored.

method.name: movement_stop
method.description: Stops the movement. With [param reset_to_start] (default) the run resets and the spawner snaps back to the start pose; otherwise it stays where it is and the run counts as finished. [method movement_play] restarts from the beginning either way. Emits no signal.

method.name: pause_shooting
method.description: Freezes volley creation keeping all counters: burst, telegraph, pattern-list and timer chains hold where they are and resume on [method resume_shooting]. Spin, retargeting and preview are unaffected. Manual [method shoot_once] still fires. Emits [signal shooting_stopped] on the active-to-idle transition (inside the tree only; a pause made before the tree is kept through _ready).

method.name: preview_sound_effect
method.description: Editor tool: plays [member BulletSpawner2D.sound_effects] entry [param index] with this spawner's mix applied (global pose, [member BulletSpawner2D.sound_volume_db] trim), so entries are audible without running the game. Wrong indexes error, null and streamless entries warn, nothing crashes. Allowed at runtime too, where it behaves like a single play.

method.name: refresh_graze_targets
method.description: Scans for graze targets now, whatever [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_update_interval] says: every bullet this spawner fired (still flying, orphaned or not) tests the nodes found from its next tick on. Call it right after spawning enemies when the interval is long. Returns how many targets it has now (every zone rings the same ones; this spawner never counts). Pushes an error and returns 0 outside the scene tree. Homing's counterpart is [method retarget_live_volleys].

method.name: refresh_sound_listeners
method.description: Scans for listeners now (whatever sound_listener_update_interval says): the bullets this spawner fired measure from the nodes found from their next tick on. Returns how many listeners it has now.

method.name: reset_shooting
method.description: Resets the volley counter, clears pause and any [method fire_n_volleys] budget, clears burst/telegraph chains and the pattern-list queue, re-arms the timer with [member BulletSpawner2D.shoot_initial_delay_sec] and the retarget clock, and emits [signal shooting_started] when auto-shooting resumes (inside the tree only).

method.name: reset_spin_angle
method.description: Resets the spin angle to zero (a random phase with [member BulletSpawner2D.spin_random_start_phase]); the next shot and the preview use it at once.

method.name: resolve_graze_targets
method.description: The [Node2D] targets the runtime tests right now, as [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_target_source] finds them (between scans: the nodes the last scan found), in tree order, this spawner excluded. The point sources give their positions instead: the cursor ([Vector2], one entry) or every entry of [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_global_positions] in order. Every zone of [member BulletSpawner2D.graze_zones] rings the same targets. No cap.

method.name: resolve_sound_listeners
method.description: The listeners the runtime measures from right now (Node2D entries, Vector2 for point sources, empty for Godot's listener).

method.name: resume_shooting
method.description: Clears [method pause_shooting]: frozen chains continue where they held. Emits [signal shooting_started] on the idle-to-active transition (inside the tree only).

method.name: set_bullet_factory
method.description: Assigns the factory directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: set_helper_aimed_target
method.description: Assigns the shared aimed target (Aimed cone and Corridor wall) directly. Pass null to clear it.

method.name: set_helper_path2d_node
method.description: Assigns the Path2D node used by the Path2D pattern layout. Updates [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_path2d_path] to point at it and refreshes the editor preview. Pass null to clear it. A node that is not a [Path2D] is refused with an error (the old one is kept), like [member BulletSpawner2D.helper_path2d_path].

method.name: set_movement_path_node
method.description: Assigns the [Path2D] to move along and stores its path in [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_path].

method.name: set_spin_angle_deg
method.description: Sets the current spin angle in degrees (wrapped to 0..360) in Continuous spin mode: the next shot and the editor preview use it at once, and the spin carries on from there. A non-finite angle is refused with an error and the angle is kept. In Oscillate mode the angle follows [member BulletSpawner2D.spin_amplitude_deg] and [member BulletSpawner2D.spin_frequency_hz], so the call is refused with an error naming [method reset_spin_angle].

method.name: set_transforms_generator
method.description: Assigns the generator directly. Pass null to use this spawner instead. Takes effect right away, in the editor and at runtime.

method.name: shoot_from
method.description: Fires one shot like [method shoot_once], posed at [param global_transform] instead of the generator's transform, turned by [param extra_spin_deg] on top of the current spin: the whole pattern, as if the generator stood there (Children markers, a Path2D drawn at its node and a local [member BulletSpawner2D.spawn_position_offset] move and turn with the pose; homing range, nearest-target picks and the fire arc measure from it). Fire a boss pattern from a weak point, from a bullet (emitter bullets use it) or anywhere a script decides. It counts as a shot (signals, [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys], budgets), is never telegraphed and inherits none of the spawner's own movement velocity. A non-finite or singular transform is refused with an error, and like [method shoot_once] it is refused from inside this spawner's shot signals (use call_deferred).

method.name: shoot_once
method.description: Fires one volley now. Returns false when misconfigured or the factory refuses it. Counts toward [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] and any [method fire_n_volleys] budget. Safe to call from _physics_process (same-shape pool reuse applies immediately; only a shape-type change waits for a safe point). Must not be called re-entrantly from inside spawner signal handlers (pre_shoot, homing_targets_resolved, volley_homing_configured, volley_fired, volley_skipped, shooting_finished): nested calls are rejected, use [method shoot_once_deferred] (or call_deferred("shoot_once")) instead. This also means intentional synchronous cascades (a handler firing another spawner immediately) are deferred by one frame by design. If a handler frees or re-homes the volley mid-setup (including pre_shoot, which is validated before configuring), the shot is safely dropped (returns false) instead of emitting volley_fired with a dead instance.

method.name: shoot_once_deferred
method.description: Queues a [method shoot_once] with call_deferred so it runs after the current emission / physics step instead of nesting. Use this from spawner signal handlers or colliding contexts. Returns true once queued (the shot itself reports through volley_fired or volley_skipped); false when the spawner is not inside the tree.

method.name: shoot_once_with
method.description: Fires one volley like [method shoot_once] with temporary overrides: [param overrides] takes the keys of a [method spawn_pattern_list] entry ([code]"preset"[/code], [code]"pattern_source"[/code], [code]"helper_bullets_amount"[/code], [code]"spawn_data"[/code]) with the same checks and errors (an unknown key names the closest valid one and is skipped). After the shot, every setting the overrides changed returns to the spawner's own value; edits a shot handler makes to other settings stick. Counts as a normal shot ([signal volley_fired], [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys], [method fire_n_volleys] budgets, the nested-call refusal of [method shoot_once]) and never emits [signal pattern_list_finished]. Returns true when the volley fired.

method.name: spawn_pattern_list
method.description: Fires pattern entries: each entry is a Dictionary with optional "preset", "pattern_source", "helper_bullets_amount" and "spawn_data" keys. Every entry is a temporary override: after it fires, every setting the entry changed (anything a preset entry changed included, the spin angle too) returns to the spawner's own value, while edits a shot handler makes to other settings while the entry fires stick. Sequential mode (default) fires one entry per interval_sec; simultaneous mode fires all at once. Returns entries queued (sequential) or volleys fired (simultaneous). Bad entries and unknown keys fail loud and are skipped, never aborting the list. Both modes emit [signal pattern_list_finished] once at the end. A new list (or [method stop_pattern_list]) replaces the running one, which then fires nothing more and never reports finished; this holds inside a handler too, and a sequential list started from a handler during a simultaneous list runs after it.

method.name: stop_pattern_list
method.description: Cancels the active pattern list (queued entries are dropped, fired volleys keep flying).

method.name: teleport
method.description: Moves the spawner to [param new_global_position] without travel: the jump is never reported as movement velocity, so [member BulletSpawner2D.inherit_movement_velocity] gives the next shot no kick. A playing Path2D movement continues from the new spot with the same path shape (Relative To Start shifts its start, Attach shifts the path by the jump until the movement is stopped or played from the start). With [param carry_live_bullets], every live or parked volley this spawner owns moves by the same jump ([method BulletVolley2D.teleport_shift_all_bullets]: no hits, grazes or homing reach along the way). The preview follows without a rebuild. A non-finite position, or a spawner outside the scene tree, is refused with an error and nothing moves.

method.name: volleys_remaining
method.description: Volleys left before [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] trips or the [method fire_n_volleys] budget runs out, whichever is smaller. -1 means unlimited (no cap and no budget left).

signal.name: burst_finished
signal.description: Fired once whenever a burst chain ends: after its last shot, when it aborts after a full burst's worth of consecutive failed shots (a failed shot is retried, never silently consumed; each attempt reports through volley_skipped), or when it is cancelled (auto-fire or burst mode switched off, burst_count shrunk to the shots already fired or fewer, [method reset_shooting], or a new [method begin_burst] over a running chain, which then reports its own end too).

signal.name: burst_shot_fired
signal.description: Fired for every shot inside a burst chain, with the 1-based shot number and whether this shot fired mirrored. The mirror rhythm always starts plain: plain, mirrored, plain, ... for any burst_count.

signal.name: movement_endpoint_reached
signal.description: Emitted each time a leg reaches its endpoint. [param at_end] is true at the path end, false at the path start. Fires before [signal movement_loop_completed] or [signal movement_finished] for the same leg.

signal.name: movement_finished
signal.description: Emitted once when a finite run completes (Once mode, or after [member BulletSpawner2D.movement_loops] legs). Not emitted by [method movement_stop].

signal.name: movement_loop_completed
signal.description: Emitted after each completed leg that is not the last one (Loop and Ping Pong). [param leg_index] is the 0-based index of the leg that just finished.

signal.name: movement_started
signal.description: Emitted when the movement starts or resumes playing ([method movement_play] or autostart).

signal.name: pattern_list_finished
signal.description: Fired once when a pattern list completes, in both modes (sequential: after the last entry fires; simultaneous: after all entries fired).

signal.name: shooting_finished
signal.description: Fired when the volley counter reaches [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] while auto-shooting is enabled. Manual shots on a spawner with [member BulletSpawner2D.shooting_enabled] off never report it.

signal.name: shooting_started
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns on.

signal.name: shooting_stopped
signal.description: Fired when automatic shooting turns off: [member BulletSpawner2D.shooting_enabled] switched off, [method pause_shooting] (also when a [method fire_n_volleys] budget is spent), or [member BulletSpawner2D.max_volleys] lowered onto the volleys already fired. Reaching the cap reports [signal shooting_finished] instead.

signal.name: volley_skipped
signal.description: Fired whenever a shot does not produce a volley, with the reason: "no_factory", "no_spawn_data", "no_transforms" (empty pattern), "over_budget" (max_live_bullets), "outside_despawn_bounds" (the muzzle is outside the factory's despawn bounds, see [member BulletSpawner2D.shoot_outside_despawn_bounds]), "outside_fire_arc" (homing fire arc), "factory_refused" (the factory rejected the spawn) or "dropped" (a handler freed or took over the volley before it was configured). Games can fall back on these instead of reading the log.

signal.name: volley_telegraphed
signal.description: Fired when a telegraph warning starts, with a snapshot of the current aim (advisory: the actual fire re-collects transforms). Draw warning lines, flash markers, play the cue.

The Node2D children of [member BulletSpawner2D.sound_listener_children_parent_path].

Live Path2D curve layout (baked points, re-sampled every volley, generator-local). Bullets sit exactly on the curve per helper_path2d_distribution (Fixed Spacing default 32px, or Even over the whole length), facing tangent-first per helper_path2d_facing (Along Path default, Normal +90/-90 across it).

Diamond (rhombus) perimeter from its diagonals, slots spread evenly by arc length, facing outward (or inward). Full outline-layout support.
